title: Sleepy butterfly
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- upper wings -->
    <ellipse cx='30' cy='32' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ff9b4a' transform='rotate(-22 30 32)'/>
    <ellipse cx='70' cy='32' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#ff9b4a' transform='rotate(22 70 32)'/>
    <!-- upper wing inner shading -->
    <ellipse cx='31' cy='33' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#ffd166' transform='rotate(-22 31 33)'/>
    <ellipse cx='69' cy='33' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#ffd166' transform='rotate(22 69 33)'/>
    <!-- upper wing spots -->
    <circle cx='27' cy='29' r='4' fill='#e85d3d'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='29' r='4' fill='#e85d3d'/>
    <!-- lower wings -->
    <ellipse cx='34' cy='64' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#7cc7a6' transform='rotate(18 34 64)'/>
    <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#7cc7a6' transform='rotate(-18 66 64)'/>
    <ellipse cx='35' cy='65' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#c8f0d8' transform='rotate(18 35 65)'/>
    <ellipse cx='65' cy='65' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#c8f0d8' transform='rotate(-18 65 65)'/>
    <circle cx='38' cy='72' r='3' fill='#4f9e83'/>
    <circle cx='62' cy='72' r='3' fill='#4f9e83'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='6' ry='22' fill='#c08ad1'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3' ry='18' fill='#e6bdf2'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='7' fill='#c08ad1'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='27' r='4' fill='#e6bdf2'/>
    <!-- antennae -->
    <path d='M47 22 Q42 12 36 10' stroke='#c08ad1' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M53 22 Q58 12 64 10' stroke='#c08ad1' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <circle cx='36' cy='10' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <circle cx='64' cy='10' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
    <!-- sleepy closed eyes -->
    <path d='M45 27 Q47.5 29.5 50 27' stroke='#5a3568' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M50 27 Q52.5 29.5 55 27' stroke='#5a3568' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
